model.name: merge.applyAllMenu
model.description: The 'Apply All' toolbar button (relabelled from 'Apply All Non-Conflicting' per Tron) opens a popup (openApplyAllMenu) offering 3 auto-resolve modes: 'Non-conflicting only' (existing applyAllNonConflicting 2b630af1/91c452ae - non-conflicting changes, conflicts remain), 'All - Local wins' + 'All - Repo wins' (applyAllFromSide 5fa11089). Tron ruling: 3-mode ADD, existing non-conflicting mode STAYS (not dead).
